answer: Weight accrues only from attestations received from non-kin identities and is consumed when the identity is transferred, so a history cannot be sold, lent or copied, and a fresh key always starts at zero. Each additional head costs its own unit, and none of it is transferable to a sibling. Treat credit as a gale that only outsiders can mint, an echo that rejects kin, and a dawn that is spent on use: the farm owns many keys and zero gale, and no amount of echo or dawn can be self-issued. Each usable unit of credit needs one honest stranger.
